clues.text: This city sits in the far north of Israel, in a hilly land called Galilee. It is the highest city in the whole country.
clues.narrowing: rules out everything outside northern Israel and the Galilee hills

source.quote: Located at an elevation of up to 937 m (3,074 ft), Safed is the highest city in the Galilee and in Israel.

clues.text: High ground gives this city warm summers and cold winters with snow at times. The height is why winter can turn white here.
clues.narrowing: narrows to high ground in that region with a warm-summer, snowy-winter rhythm

clues.text: Judaism counts this city as one of its four most holy spots. Just three more towns in the world hold that same high rank.
